content: Taukuma wainasinama

Yesu Galili yawawinama diane waikatakatai yai kare munaḡena. Be patara dosinama a rawateḡeidina aubainama, tauna topae waga debane ya saḡa be ya miana. Be patara matabudi taudi barabarae upa diane a miana.
Tauna wainasie yaba toitoi yai katakataidi be ya riuedina,
“Koi beavaia! Raḡan tenaḡa taukuma ya naḡona pesi kumanama aubainama.
Raḡanine pesi yawai yaraiedina, ḡesaudima keda poune a ravusedina be kiu a tava be a kanidina.
Be ḡesaudima yeku debedie a ravusedina, dabudine nam doḡa dosina aubainama pesi a gogo makaina, baninama doḡa nam i potopoto guratana.
Be raḡanine suara ya tavatavana, pesi ya kara gabedi be a pokina, baninama taudi waramidima nam ti yovo guratana.
Be pesi ḡesaudima gedara nopodie a ravusedi be gedara pesi a gogogona a yavanidina. Vutuna aubainama taudi nam ti banina.
Be yaḡoro pesi ḡesaudima doḡa verene a gogona. Naumeki da a gogotava, a moraba be a banina, ḡesaudima banidima 30, ḡesaudima 60, bo 100.”
Dabudine Yesu ya riuna, “Deḡoda beemima ta kenana, koi beavaia!”
Raḡanine Yesu taunaḡa, be banaga aitauḡa tauna a vaivaiena, tauwai muriwatana 12 mate a tava be tauna ai baḡa da tauna na wainasima baninama aba.
Naumeki da Yesu ya paribeedi be ya riuna, “Taumi Mamaitua na waiguyauma semosemonama ya utemina. Be banaga ḡesaudima ḡavoe miemienidima, taudi yaba matabudi wainasie yà riuedina:

content.text: ‘Vutuna aubainama taudi ta kitakitana be nam tima kitakita kauena,
be vaienama ta vaivaiena be nam tima vaivaiena,
vutuna aubainama taudi nam Mamaitua ḡarone tima tavatava be adi gewagewama ima noḡonoḡota poredina.’

content: Dabudine Yesu yai taraviredina, “Taumi uma wainasinama nam ko kataie, bo? Be nema wainasi ḡesaudima ko katai bakedi?
Taukuma Mamaitua riunama ewai yaraiedina.

Be banaga ḡesaudima maika pesi keda debane ravuravusedima, deḡo Mamaitua riunama ya kumakumae. Raḡanine riu ta vaivaiena, Seitan waiḡapa e tava be Mamaitua riunama nopodie kumakumanama e kaikaiporaḡana.
Be banaga ḡesaudima maika pesi yeku debedie ravuravusedima. Taudi riu ta vaie be raḡan tenaḡa ma nuaveredi ta paḡopaḡona,
baninama taudi nam waramidi aubainama taudi nam ta midi gurata. Raḡanine gewagewa bo raukivigewagewa e tavana, baninama Mamaitua riunama aubainama, taudi waiḡapa tai daberaridina.
Be mate ḡesaudima maika pesi gedara nopodie ravuravusedima, riu ta vaivaiena,
be dobu yawasanidima nuaboyedi, dobu waiguyaudima be yaba ḡesaudima adi wainuapaḡoma mate ta saḡa be Mamaitua riunama ta yavanidi be nam tima banibanina.
Be banaga ḡesaudima taudi maika pesi doḡa verene kumakumanama, taudi riu ta vaie, ta paḡopaḡo, ta vovo teyeteyedi, be votedima ḡesaudima 30, ḡesaudima 60 bo 100.”
Kodam wainasinama
Yesu ya riuedina, “Nam aitau kodam ya saḡe be gurewa dibune bo vatara dibune ya boru. Bo tokare ḡavoe koyai midiri bo ibewa?
Aba da moimoisirinama tokare e neganegana be aba rupurupunama tokare e maḡatarana.
Aitauḡa da beemima e kenakenana, koi beavaia kauana!
Aba yà riuriuemina, koi beavaia kaua!” Mate ya riuedina, “Ruvanama ko rarau ruvena teneḡine nama Mamaitua taumi e ruvemina bo e tausaḡena.
Aitau uma yabedima kwa katakataiedina, tam tokare Mamaitua debane e taipotodina. Deḡoda aitau uma yabedima nam ku kataiedina, tam tokare avedi da ḡaubonama ḡarome be Mamaitua matabudi e kaiporaḡana.”
Pesi mabine gogogonama wainasinama
Be mate Yesu ya riuedina, “Mamaitua na waiguyauma maika umanama: Tauḡoma pesi na sipie yai yaraiedina.
Be kupi da suara tauna e kenakena bo e miamia nuababaḡana, be nam ima katakataiena nema pesi ta gogogogo bakona.
Be doḡa taunaḡa e voie da pesi ta gogo be ta banibanina, noḡone rugudima ta biridina, murine ta rovena, yodibe banidima nopodie ta biridina.
Raḡanine yaḡoda ta ḡouḡouna, tauḡoma na biriukoma e paḡo be taraḡidima ei karena, baninama dariḡa na raḡanima ya tavana.”
Gaga pesinama wainasinama
Yesu yai taravirana, “Mamaitua na waiguyauma nema tà giu bake, bo aba wainasinama tà voie da e kawa didimani?
Inam maika gaga pesinama, nito ḡominama doḡa nopone ko kumakumana nama.
Raḡanine e gogogona, tauna e moraba guratana, nam maika pesi ḡesaudima sipie ta gogogona nama. Be tauna raga yaveyaveḡinama vagurune kiu ḡavoḡa rovorovodima ta verau be ta raunoḡina.”
Yesu wainasi toitoi banaga ḡarodie ya rauguguyena, maika uma wainasinama nama ya giu guratedi da banaga ta kataiedina.
Tauna nam airaḡan wainasi i gose be ḡarodie i giu ḡomana, be raḡanine na tauwai muriwatanama mate taudiḡa be tauna yaba matabuna ḡarodie ya giu waibatena.
Yesu kaibitibiti ewai badena
Inam raḡaninama teneḡine ravie, Yesu na tauwai muriwatanama ya riuedina, “Yawawa tà davu be tà naḡo noaḡo nevane.”
Naumeki da patara a gosedi be Yesu deḡo wagane ya miamiae dabudine tauwai muriwatana a geru be tauna mate a naḡona. Be waga ḡesaudima dabudi mate.
Yai raḡantenaḡe da sive bagibaginama ya tava be rabama ya nuayemra da ḡaubonaḡa sibo waga nopone upa ya moḡavuna.

Be Yesu tauna waga murine, debanama kunuane ya boru be ya kenakenana. Be na tauwai muriwatanama a rawaḡosori be a riuna, “Tauwai katakatai kwa kitakita bo ibewa da kaiteka tà gurina. Tam nam kumawai nuaboyeda, bo?”
Yesu ya midisuḡu da sive ya riutuaḡaie be ya riuna, “Kwai nuatuḡu!” Be rabama ya riuedina, “Ko rautamtamḡota!” Dabudine sive yai nuatuḡu be daumora dosinama ya kenana.
Naumeki da Yesu na tauwai muriwatanama ya riuedina, “Aba aubainama ko nainaira? Taumi nam ḡaromie waisumaḡa, bo?”
Taudi a ḡosoridi, a base be adi banagama adi banagama a riuedina, “Uma baneginama aitau? Tauna sive be rabama e riuedi be ta vovo teyeteyena.”

footnotes.text: Gurik bonane ya riuna: Gaga pesinama. Be inam gaga ḡesau, tauna kai, nam taitai. Inam gaganama pesinama nito ḡominama, nam maika pesi ḡesaudima doḡa nopone tà kumekumedina nama.
